checks.DIRECT_READS_COMPLETE: T1 — Direct meter reading: three complete readings
checks.DIRECT_VALUES_PLAUSIBLE: T2 — Plausible values (voltage, frequency, current, power, energy)
checks.POWER_UNIT_COHERENT: T2 — Power unit consistent with voltage and current
checks.DISPLAY_CONCORDANCE: T3 — Agreement with the meter display
checks.POWER_EQUALS_V_TIMES_I: T4 — Active power equals voltage multiplied by current
checks.POINT_UNITS_MATCH_METER: T7 — Platform point units: W for power, kW.h for energy
checks.NO_SAMPLES: T5 — Measurements recorded by the platform
checks.NO_MISSING_SAMPLES: T5 — No missing measurement outside a declared outage
checks.NO_DOUBLE_SAMPLING: T5 — No double measurement (two measurements too close together)
checks.INTERVAL_RESPECTED: T5 — Interval between two measurements respected
checks.ENERGY_MATCHES_POWER: T7 — Energy consistent with power multiplied by duration
checks.NO_LOSS_DURING_API_OUTAGE: T8 — No measurement lost during the API outage
checks.GATEWAY_OUTAGE_HANDLED: T9 — Gateway outage: no invented value, resumed on return
checks.RESTART_RESUMED: Daemon restart: resumed without duplicate and without energy going backwards

details.DIRECT_READS_COMPLETE: {count} reading(s), {incomplete} of them incomplete; {required} complete readings are expected.
details.DIRECT_VALUES_PLAUSIBLE: Quantities out of limits: {violations}. Nominal voltage used: {nominal_voltage} V.
details.POWER_UNIT_COHERENT: Ratio of active power to (voltage × current) between {ratio_min} and {ratio_max}; it must stay between 0.02 and 1.05.
details.DISPLAY_CONCORDANCE: Quantities compared: {compared}. Deviations out of tolerance: {deviations}.
details.POINT_UNITS_MATCH_METER: Power: class {power_class}, unit {power_unit}; energy: class {energy_class}, unit {energy_unit}. Mismatches: {mismatches}.
details.NO_SAMPLES: {power} power measurement(s) and {energy} energy measurement(s) in the period.
details.NO_DOUBLE_SAMPLING: {count} pair(s) of measurements less than half an interval apart.
details.ENERGY_MATCHES_POWER: Measured energy: {measured_kwh} kW.h; expected from power: {expected_kwh} kW.h.
details.NO_LOSS_DURING_API_OUTAGE: {lost} measurement(s) lost; {replayed} measurement(s) dated during the outage sent afterwards (about {expected} expected).
details.GATEWAY_OUTAGE_HANDLED: {invented} measurement(s) recorded during the outage; {not_resumed} outage(s) without resumption within the next two intervals.
details.RESTART_RESUMED: {not_resumed} restart(s) without resumption within the next two intervals; {energy_dropped} energy decrease(s) around the restart.

notes.gaps: Gaps found in the measurements (compare with your outage notes)
notes.no_gap: No gap longer than two intervals.
notes.not_covered: Not covered by this verdict: visual agreement with the meter display (human entry), "stale" display in the console during the gateway outage, 30-day endurance, several meters, other model, other site. This verdict is not a field validation.
notes.readonly: Read-only: only Modbus function code 04 is used; nothing is ever written to the meter.

reasons.LOAD_NOT_DECLARED_RESISTIVE: The load was not declared resistive: this check is meaningless otherwise.
reasons.DISPLAY_NOT_PROVIDED: The display values were not entered: comparison impossible.
reasons.READS_INCOMPLETE: The direct readings are incomplete: check impossible.
reasons.NO_LOAD: No load strong enough to conclude (voltage × current below 100 VA).
reasons.ENERGY_TOO_SMALL: The expected energy is too close to the meter resolution: extend the test or increase the load.
reasons.ENERGY_FROZEN: Energy did not change although power is not zero (frozen meter or simulator).
reasons.UNIT_FACTOR_SUSPECTED: The ratio is close to 1000 or 1/1000: probable unit confusion (W and kW, or W.h and kW.h).
reasons.NO_OUTAGE_DECLARED: No outage of this type was declared: test not performed.
reasons.NO_RESTART_DECLARED: No daemon restart was declared: test not performed.
